description: Source file implementing FFmpeg demuxer logic for media stream parsing, configuration, and packet handling within the starboard shared ffmpeg namespace.

classes.name: FFmpegDemuxerImpl<FFMPEG>
classes.description: Implementation of the FFmpeg demuxer handling stream initialization, configuration parsing, packet reading, and seeking.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the demuxer, opens input, finds streams, and sets up configurations.

methods.name: HasAudioStream
methods.description: Returns true if an audio stream is present.

methods.name: HasVideoStream
methods.description: Returns true if a video stream is present.

methods.name: GetDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the media in microseconds.

methods.name: GetStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the media in microseconds.

methods.name: GetTimelineOffset
methods.description: Returns the timeline offset in microseconds.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads packets from the stream, invoking callback with demuxed data.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified time in microseconds.
